notes: Initial versioned release: S3 landing zone (with inline access-keys secret support), Snowflake database + medallion schemas, and Snowflake storage integration.

Restructured module source layout to terraform/modules/<stack>/<version>/ so each module stack (e.g. aws-snowflake) can be versioned independently. No functional changes to the modules themselves — identical to 1.0.0 plus the Snowpipe module added earlier.
